h2: Pool Cleaning Nusa Dua – One-Off Service for Villas & Estates
intro: Pool Cleaning Nusa Dua covers everything from a quick pre-arrival refresh to full green-pool recovery — skimming, brushing, vacuuming, filter backwash and water balance in a single visit. In the coastal villas around Tanjung Benoa and Bualu, salt-laden air and Bukit's hard water put extra strain on heaters, fittings and tile lines, so a thorough service keeps your pool looking the way resort guests expect.

sections.h3: Salt Air, Hard Water and Big Pools
sections.text: Nusa Dua sits right on the coast, so every pool breathes salt-laden air year-round. Add Bukit's mineral-heavy supply and you get scale creeping onto heaters, limescale rings around the waterline, and corrosion on stainless fittings — especially in larger villas with overflows and cascading features. In areas like Peminge and Sawangan where pools run well above ten metres, balancing chemistry isn't optional; it's what keeps the water clear and the equipment from seizing up between guest stays.

sections.h3: What We Usually Handle Around Here
sections.text: The most common requests we get from villa managers and owners in this stretch of coast are straightforward: a pool that turned green while nobody was watching, cloudy water after heavy rain, or tile lines going brown just before a long-term tenant checks in. Gated estates around Kampial and Tanjung Benoa each have their own access rules — gate codes, security logs, restricted hours — so scheduling a visit a day or two ahead avoids any friction at the compound entrance.

Before we quote, send three or four photos on WhatsApp: the pool surface from above (so we can judge clarity and colour), the equipment area with pump, filter and heater visible, and a close-up of the waterline tiles if they look discoloured. If there's an overflow channel or a small waterfall feature, include that too. The final price depends entirely on what the job involves — a quick skim-and-balance versus a full green-pool recovery are very different scopes.

A few habits save money and headaches in this climate. Check your heater and pump fittings once a month for white scale or rust spots; wipe them down before they set. Keep pH between 7.2 and 7.6 — Bukit water pushes it high, and alkaline conditions accelerate corrosion. If you're away for more than two weeks, ask whoever has access to run the filter for an hour daily so the water doesn't go stagnant. Small, regular attention beats a big emergency clean-up every time.

faq.q: How long does a one-off pool cleaning take?
faq.a: A standard clean — skimming, brushing, vacuuming, backwash and water balance — usually fits into one working session. Green-pool recovery takes longer because the chemistry needs to stabilise before we call it done.

faq.q: Can you work inside gated estates in Nusa Dua?
faq.a: Yes. We just need the gate code or a security pass arranged in advance so there's no waiting at the compound entrance. Message us on WhatsApp with your estate name and we'll sort the access details.

faq.q: What should I do if my pool turns green while I'm away?
faq.a: Don't panic and don't dump random chemicals in. Send us photos of the water surface and the equipment area on WhatsApp; from that we can tell whether it's an algae bloom or a filter issue and quote accordingly.
